hints.title: Reversing Adjacent Pairs
hints.text: Reversing a subarray of length 2 allows swapping any two adjacent elements, enabling any arbitrary permutation.

hints.title: Frequency Equivalence
hints.text: Because any permutation is reachable, the target array can be formed if and only if both arrays have identical element frequencies.

hints.title: Compare Element Counts
hints.text: Count frequencies in target and arr. Return true if frequency distributions match, false otherwise.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of target and arr
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating actual subarray reversals is unnecessary when permutation equivalence is proven.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting frequencies takes linear time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves that reversing subarrays permits bubble sort swaps, reducing problem to multiset equality.
